pages.Immunity:
For the quest, see Immunity (quest).
Immunity is a Physical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

## Description

Immunity affects the susceptibility to illnesses and the effectiveness of their treatment.

## Effects

Reduces all negative effects from stimulants, food, water (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
Reduces poison effect force (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
Increases painkiller action time (0.6% per level → +30% at Elite Level)
Elite level: Chance to gain immunity to negative effects from stimulants, food, water (+90%)
Elite level: Chance to gain immunity to poisons (+90%)

## How to raise

Using and surviving the negative effects of Stimulants and Provisions
Completing the quest Get a Foothold
Completing the quest Profit Retention
Completing the quest Decontamination Service
Completing the quest Crisis

## Leveling Guide

Skill points are awarded at the end of a  period, not during. It can get prolonged by consuming multiple items.
The amount and types of negative effects do not influence the points gain. The points gain solely depends on the negative effect duration.
Metabolism reduces the duration of negative effects, which makes long-lasting injectors and stimulants give less points but safer to use.
Per 1 second of negative effect duration you gain ~0.0045 points.
Extracting from a raid ends the  period, giving points only for the duration of the effect up to that point.
Can of Max Energy energy drink has a minor 5-minute stress resistance debuff, so drinking one every 5 minutes is a cost-effective way to gain skill points.
2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector has a 15-minute hydration debuff, make sure to bring extra drinks.
Obdolbos 2 cocktail injector has multiple 30-minute debuffs, including a health points one, make sure to bring extra meds.

The "outside contact" that is hinted at in the dialogue and success message, is the character "Deadpool" from the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
The "amphibian pizza lovers' hideout" is a reference to the "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" franchise.
The "burned girl's sickroom" is a reference to Alessa Gillespie, one of the main characters in the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "barbed wire body" is a reference to the game "Death Stranding".
The "really scary hole in the wall" is a reference to the game "Silent Hill 4: The Room".
The "high rise where one die-hard guy kicked ass" is a reference to the movie "Die Hard".
The "computer with a joke for programmers" is not a reference to anything in particular, but shows a folder with the name "gun porn", an opened text document with binary code that decodes to "there is no escape from Tarkov" as well as an ongoing "Minesweeper" game.
The "little chair surrounded by big black chairs" is a reference to the meme "Piper Perri Surrounded".
"Your friend Wilson" is a reference to the movie "Cast Away".
The "kindled rest place" is a reference to "Dark Souls" game series.
The "ominous welcome sign" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "megagenius scientist's seat" is a reference to the "Rick and Morty" sitcom series.
The "place where conscripts did a very important task" is a reference to soldiers cleaning their barracks for visits of higher-ups, even "painting the grass green" to make a good impression.
The "two chair riddle" is a reference to a Russian prison riddle/initiation ritual "There are two chairs. One has sharp knives sticking out. The other has erect penises. Which one do you sit on and which one do you have your mother sit on?"
"Every tank driver's first videogame" is a reference to the game "Battle City".
The "bucket-head villain" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "Anvil 3-4 crew member's execution site" is a reference to the game "Battlefield 3".
"Every indie developer's worst nightmare" is a reference to the game engine "Unity", which the game is made with. The developers have mentioned multiple times that the engine was not the best choice for the game.
The "room where the firefighter burned the books to become happy" is a reference to the novel "Fahrenheit 451".
The "place where some valve technicians couldn't finish their third project" is a reference to the unannounced game "Half-Life 3" from the developer Valve.
The "dangerous Russian chocolate beauty" is a reference to the chocolate brand "Alenka" and the "The Terminator" movie series.
The "conspiracy theorist's room" is a reference to the meme "Pepe Silvia".
"Where someone thought he'd get transported to the magic school" is a reference to the "Harry Potter" movie series.
The "mother of all strategy games" is a reference to the game "Minesweeper".
The "stairway to the skies" is a reference to the song "Stairway To Heaven" from Led Zeppelin.
The "bear who sat into a flaming car" is a reference to the Russian joke "Bear walks by the forest, sees a burning car. He sits inside and burns to ashes."
According to the developers, the room with the "upside-down chair" was originally planned to get a spooky atmosphere, but the idea was never finished.
The "not-so-lonely bathroom" is a reference to the meme "Versus Pooping".

You must survive a raid at each location consecutively without dying, disconnecting, or running out the timer. If you do any of these you will have to start again. If you extract from the raid with a "Run Through" status, you will not reset the quest, but that raid will not count as being completed. ## Guide

Dehydration and broken bones cause pain. Easiest way to break your leg bones is to fall a few meters or to intentionally fail the Hideout gym training to break your arm.
Using a Jar of DevilDog mayo is an easy way to achieve pain through dehydration, although it comes with the side effect of constant damage over time.
Using painkillers, morphine and/or similar medication will remove the status effect, and as such kills will not count towards the quest.
pages.The Survivalist Path - Zhivchik:
The Survivalist Path - Zhivchik is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

## Guide

You can consume certain items that decrease your hydration to quickly get into the dehydration state. For example, a Jar of DevilDog mayo gives -99 and a Can of condensed milk -65 hydration. You can also use the gym module in your hideout to drain energy and hydration before starting a raid.
Alternatively, if you play with friends, you can ask them to shoot you in the stomach, which will get you into the dehydration state too. Keep in mind that this will also decrease your energy rapidly.
Don't forget to bring enough Meds or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector to outheal the damage, and enough Drinks to continue the raid afterwards.
If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" extraction status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. If you happen to get a run through, you can survive and extract from another raid on any location to complete the quest.

## Trivia

Zhivchik (живчик) translates roughly to "lively" or "peppy".
